title: 53rd Writers Guild of America Awards

{{Use mdy dates|date=February 2019}} {{WGA awards short description|works-year=2000}} {{Infobox film awards|number=53|award=WGA Awards|date=March 4, 2001|organizer=[[Writers Guild of America, East]] and the [[Writers Guild of America, West]]|last=[[52nd Writers Guild of America Awards|52nd]]|next=[[54th Writers Guild of America Awards|54th]]}} The '''53rd [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''' honored the best writing in film, television and radio of 2000. Nominees for television and radio were announced on January 10, 2001, while nominees for film were announced on February 7, 2001.{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2001/film/awards/guild-counts-on-character-1117794246/|title=Guild counts on character|last=Bergman|first=Anne|date=February 25, 2001|website=Variety|access-date=March 7, 2019}} Winners were announced on March 4, 2001, in joint ceremonies at [[The Beverly Hilton]] hotel in [[Beverly Hills, California]], and at the [[Plaza Hotel]] in [[New York City]]. The ceremonies were hosted by [[Geoffrey Rush]], [[Greg Kinnear]], [[Kelsey Grammer]], and [[Stockard Channing]].{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2001/film/news/wga-inks-4-presenters-1117794480/|title=WGA inks 4 presenters|last=McNary|first=Dave|date=February 28, 2001|website=Variety|access-date=March 7, 2019}} ==Winners and nominees== ===Notes=== * Nominees for television and radio were originally broadcast between September 1, 1999, and August 31, 2000.{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2001/tv/news/nbc-tops-wga-tv-noms-1117791658/|title=NBC tops WGA TV noms|last=McNary|first=Dave|date=January 10, 2001|website=Variety|access-date=March 7, 2019}} * Winners are in bold (some categories resulted in a tie, allowing two winners for some awards).{{cite web |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |title=Writers Guild Awards Winners: 2005-1996 |work=wga.org |publisher=Writers Guild of America |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260217142826/https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |archive-date=2026-02-17 |access-date=2026-02-20 |url-status=live }}{{cite web|url=https://www.imdb.com/event/ev0000710/2001/1/?ref_=ev_eh|title=Writers Guild of America 2001 Awards|website=IMDb|access-date=March 11, 2019}} ===Film=== {| class=wikitable style="width=100%" |- !
